thread:
alex: Heads up — after rolling Cilium 1.25.2 -> 1.25.4 in eu-west1 tonight we're seeing intermittent east-west packet drops on GPU training pods. Latency is sawtoothing and some RDMA connects are timing out. @sam can you take a look?

sam: On it. Any specific nodes / AZs? example pod IDs or job IDs?

alex: Mostly nc-gpu-*-pool in eu-west1-b. Pod->pod pings show intermittent 1-20% packet loss, spikes every ~60s. dmesg on linda03 has repeated NETDEV messages. Quick snippets: 

```
$ ping -c 10 10.32.5.12
--- 10.32.5.12 ping statistics ---
10 packets transmitted, 9 received, 10% packet loss, time 9005ms
rtt min/avg/max/mdev = 0.421/1.230/8.912/2.134 ms
```

```
[ 1234.567890] NETDEV WATCHDOG: geneve0 (geneve): transmit queue 0 timed out
[ 1234.567895] geneve0: renaming to old_geneve0
```

alex: Also saw iperf3 show sudden drops in throughput when p95 latency spikes.

priya: We saw something vaguely similar after the tunnel rewrite months ago. Did the daemonset change tunnel mode or MTU handling in the patch?

miguel: cilium config from the new image shows `tunnel: geneve` and `mtu: 8950` in the daemonset, but host links on some nodes report 1500. That MTU mismatch would explain fragmentation/seen drops. Also observed RDMA handshake timeouts in logs (ib0). Looks like interfaces are being recreated without preserving host MTU during CNI hot-reload.

alex: Good catch. We observed drift 8950 -> 1500 on host veths after the agent restarted on a subset of nodes. Rolling update paused. @deploy-bot can you start rollback if we can't patch quickly?

deploy-bot: Rollback queued: cilium-daemonset -> image cilium:v1.25.2. Creating rollout plan now.

sam: Temp mitigation applied on affected nodes: enabled MSS clamping and tcp MTU probing. Commands run: 

```
sudo sysctl -w net.ipv4.tcp_mtu_probing=1
sudo iptables -t mangle -A POSTROUTING -p tcp -j TCPMSS --clamp-mss-to-pmtu
```

sam: After that we saw packet loss drop to ~1-2% and fewer RDMA reconnect attempts. Not a long-term fix.

priya: We should also check conntrack interactions with ib0 (RDMA). Maybe temporarily bypass nf_conntrack for ib0 traffic while we root-cause. Also check K8s CNI chaining behavior for host-device plugins.

miguel: Plan: pause rollout, collect tcpdumps on geneve/veth/ib0, capture `ip -s link` and `ethtool -k` on each node in pool, run iperf3 with jumbo frames to confirm MTU behavior. I'll drop a probe script to /usr/local/bin/eu-west1-mtu-probe.sh and schedule immediate run.

alex: Please tar logs to /tmp/cilium-mtu-drift/<node>.tgz and upload to the incident bucket. We'll correlate with GPU job IDs and scheduling events — note ~6 GPUs across nodes were idle for ~20m while jobs retried, cost impact ~partial-hour billing.

sam: If rollback doesn't clear within 30m, escalate to infra-hardware for RDMA firmware checks (just in case). Also will open a Cilium issue with reproduction steps.

alex: Thanks all. Keeping oncall posted. :warning:

(Attachments: small tcpdump excerpt, daemonset pod logs, iperf output saved to /var/log/ci/cilium-mtu-drift.log)
